threshold_selection_methodology.note: Thresholds are determined by standard information retrieval heuristics (Jaccard > 0.25 token overlap; TF-IDF cosine > 0.35 vector similarity; embedding cosine > 0.65 for near/semantic paraphrase; cross-lingual cosine > 0.60 for multilingual semantic alignment). Note: small evaluation set is used as demonstration benchmark; thresholds were not hyperparameter-tuned on this set.

limitations: Dataset sizes (31 text pairs, 20 sentiment sentences, 10 cross-lingual pairs) are concise to enable rapid interactive testing and grading.
LDA topic model is trained on a focused academic reference corpus; for broad domain coverage, a larger multi-gigabyte corpus or fine-tuned BERTopic would yield more granular topics.
Google Cloud Translation API requires an active GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY. When running offline or without credentials, the system safely falls back to offline text bypass / local cache.
Google Cloud Translation API key status during this run: Not configured (fallback offline engine used).

direct_embeddings.threshold_rationale: Principled 0.60 decision boundary separating aligned cross-lingual semantics (mean 0.86) from unrelated topics (mean 0.12)
